setup: Independent verifier provisions a fresh disposable Linux VM/daemon; attest ownership, isolation and exact daemon /info ID. Do not use production daemon, shared socket, unrelated containers or CI pool authority.

Preload exact released baseline and reviewed immutable repair images. Run verification entrypoint in repair-image Python runtime, PYTHONPATH=/app/src, exposing only the disposable daemon at /staging/docker.sock; copy this script into that temporary runtime. Record actual code hashes in runtime and compare reviewed migration.py/updates.py hashes.

Set UPDATER_STAGING_SOCKET=/staging/docker.sock, UPDATER_STAGING_DISPOSABLE=1, exact UPDATER_STAGING_DAEMON_ID, UPDATER_STAGING_OLD_IMAGE=<immutable baseline>, UPDATER_STAGING_REPAIR_IMAGE=<immutable repair>. These inputs contain no secrets.

Execute python3 /proof/staging-check.py. Capture stdout/stderr/exit and repair image digest, source/code hashes and VM destruction receipt. No Docker build/pull/publication is performed by the script.
pass_signal: exit0 and JSON status pass; two real daemon scenarios completed/rolled_back, exact new/old image IDs, real Docker health and retained synthetic history sentinel; clean teardown of uniquely named test containers/volume; independently verify disposal.
fault_injection: UnhealthyCandidate changes only candidate HEALTHCHECK at real Docker create boundary. This forces actual daemon unhealthy state and production readiness/recovery logic; no mocked successful stop/health. Both source containers ignore TERM and exercise normal13s force-stop grace.
relation_to_local_tests: Real socket default15s/13s grace/15.25s delayed ACK test is separately executable; staging proves daemon/image/data/recovery integration, not artificially delayed daemon ACK.
limitations: Environment flag asserts isolation; independent operator evidence is mandatory and not proved by flag.
Script must run using frozen repaired image code, not arbitrary host source.
Staging is representative validation only; installed LTX updater identity and one actual retry acceptance remain separate held outcomes.
release_impact: No production retry before full-duration GREEN and disposable Docker proof; no release/production acceptance claim from local tests.
artifact_location_note: One-off validation runner retained outside shipped source; original and independent executed copies/proofs are in run artifacts.
